source: Dossier 11 §D10.9 — packing code to Armenian package noun, 8 rows and 2 defaults.
note: Used by the box 31 quantity segment. Keyed on the same codes as packing_codes.json. Filed descriptions use packaging nouns as counting units, so the noun is part of the arithmetic's wording and not decoration.
nouns_note: The pack-math form filed by real declarants is 'N <package noun> M ՀԱՏԱՆՈՑ-T ՀԱՏ' — N packages of M each, T pieces in total.
